whyNow.cloudAct.description: Data transiting through a US provider's infrastructure is accessible to US authorities — even when hosted in Europe. This includes API traffic metadata.

featureCards.title: Everything you need to govern AI agents
featureCards.mcp.title: MCP Gateway
featureCards.mcp.metric: Every AI agent action audited and governed
featureCards.mcp.desc: Native Model Context Protocol gateway. AI agents discover and call your APIs through a secure, governed endpoint. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, RBAC, full audit trail.
featureCards.bridge.title: Legacy Bridge
featureCards.bridge.metric: SOAP & webMethods APIs accessible to AI in days
featureCards.bridge.desc: Connect existing enterprise APIs to the AI agent ecosystem. No rewrite needed — STOA translates protocols, federates identity, and adds governance.
featureCards.uac.title: Universal API Contract
featureCards.uac.metric: One contract, every protocol — halve your API surface management
featureCards.uac.desc: Define once, expose as REST and MCP. OpenAPI auto-transforms with schema validation at the edge. No duplication, no drift.
featureCards.observability.title: AI Observability
featureCards.observability.metric: Token metering per team — know exactly what AI costs you
featureCards.observability.desc: Full-stack observability for API and AI agent traffic. Token consumption per tenant, distributed tracing, real-time dashboards. Grafana + Loki + Tempo included.
featureCards.portal.title: Self-Service Portal
featureCards.portal.metric: Developers onboard in minutes, not weeks of tickets
featureCards.portal.desc: A developer portal where teams discover, test, and subscribe to APIs and MCP tools. Self-service onboarding with automatic key provisioning.

differentiators.title: What Makes STOA Different
differentiators.description: Four pillars that define the STOA approach to AI agent governance.
differentiators.mcp.title: MCP-Native
differentiators.mcp.subtitle: Governance for AI agents, not just APIs.
differentiators.mcp.description: MCP is built into the core — not bolted on as a plugin. Every API you publish is instantly governed and accessible to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol.
differentiators.uac.title: Universal API Contract
differentiators.uac.subtitle: Define once, expose everywhere.
differentiators.uac.description: One contract powers REST and MCP endpoints. Change once, propagate to all consumers automatically. No duplication, no protocol-specific maintenance.
differentiators.sovereign.title: European Sovereign
differentiators.sovereign.subtitle: Built in France. Hosted in Europe.
differentiators.sovereign.description: The US Cloud Act allows American authorities to access data held by US providers — even in Europe. STOA is built and hosted under European jurisdiction. GDPR-native, NIS2-ready, DORA-supportive.
differentiators.oss.title: True Open Source
differentiators.oss.subtitle: Apache 2.0 core. Enterprise support available.
differentiators.oss.description: Full Apache 2.0 license — no BSL, no feature gates, no surprise relicensing. Enterprise support, SLAs, and managed deployment available for teams that need them.

pricingFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pricingFaq.description: Everything you need to know about STOA pricing, deployment, and compliance.
pricingFaq.a1: Yes. STOA is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. You can self-host the full platform at no cost, forever. No usage limits, no feature gates, no trial expiration. Enterprise and Sovereign plans add support, SLAs, and managed services.
pricingFaq.q2: What's included in the Community plan?
pricingFaq.a2: The full platform: MCP Gateway, Control Plane API, Console UI, Developer Portal, multi-gateway orchestration, UAC, basic observability, and community support via GitHub and Discord.
pricingFaq.a3: Enterprise pricing is based on your deployment scale and support needs. Contact our team for a custom quote. We offer flexible options for both cloud-hosted and on-premise deployments.
pricingFaq.q4: Can we deploy STOA on-premise or air-gapped?
pricingFaq.a4: Yes. STOA is designed for on-premise, hybrid, and air-gapped deployments. The entire platform runs on your infrastructure — nothing phones home. Helm charts and Docker images are provided.
pricingFaq.a5: STOA supports compliance with DORA requirements — it does not guarantee compliance by itself. Features include: full audit trail for AI and API actions, ICT third-party risk documentation, on-premise deployment for data residency, and exportable compliance reports. Your compliance team should evaluate STOA as part of your broader DORA program.
pricingFaq.a6: Yes. Sovereign plan customers can conduct penetration testing against their STOA deployment. We provide documentation for security assessments and can coordinate with your security team.
pricingFaq.q7: How do we migrate from another API gateway?
pricingFaq.a7: STOA provides migration guides for Kong, Gravitee, Apigee, webMethods, Azure APIM, and AWS API Gateway. The multi-gateway orchestration feature lets you run STOA alongside your existing gateway during transition — no big-bang migration required.
pricingFaq.a8: STOA is built by CAB Ingénierie, a French company with 15+ years of experience in enterprise integration (webMethods, API Management, identity federation). The platform is open source under Apache 2.0.
pricingFaq.footer: Still have questions? Get in touch

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — STOA Platform
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for STOA Platform. How we handle your data, analytics, and communications.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Who We Are
privacy.section1.text: STOA Platform is an open-source API management project maintained by CAB Ingenierie, a French consulting company. This policy covers the website gostoa.dev and associated services (portal.gostoa.dev, console.gostoa.dev, docs.gostoa.dev).
privacy.section2.title: 2. Data We Collect
privacy.section2.analytics: Website analytics: We use Vercel Analytics to collect anonymous, aggregated page view data. No cookies are set. No personal data is collected by analytics.
privacy.section2.newsletter: Newsletter: If you subscribe to our newsletter (via Buttondown), we store your email address to send updates. You can unsubscribe at any time.
privacy.section2.accounts: Portal / Console accounts: When you create an account on portal.gostoa.dev, we collect your email and name via Keycloak (self-hosted authentication). This data is stored on European infrastructure (OVH, France).
privacy.section2.contact: Contact forms: Emails sent to hello@gostoa.dev, demo@gostoa.dev, or sales@gostoa.dev are processed by our team and not shared with third parties.
privacy.section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
privacy.section3.item1: Provide and improve the STOA Platform services
privacy.section3.item3: Respond to demo requests and support inquiries
privacy.section3.note: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section4.title: 4. Data Storage & Security
privacy.section4.text: All platform data is hosted on European infrastructure (OVH GRA9). Authentication is managed by self-hosted Keycloak. No data is stored on US-based cloud providers for production services.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Your Rights (GDPR)
privacy.section5.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
privacy.section5.item4: Export your data in a portable format
privacy.section5.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at
privacy.section6.title: 6. Cookies
privacy.section6.text: gostoa.dev does not use tracking cookies. Vercel Analytics is cookie-free. Authentication sessions on portal/console use secure, HTTP-only session cookies strictly necessary for the service.
privacy.section7.title: 7. Contact
